phase4_cv_context.note: Cross-validation scores were derived strictly from the 5 training folds.

metric_definitions_and_interpretations.RMSE: Root Mean Squared Error: Measures standard deviation of residuals; penalizes large errors. Lower is better.
metric_definitions_and_interpretations.MAE: Mean Absolute Error: Average absolute prediction error in dataset price units. Lower is better.
metric_definitions_and_interpretations.Median_Absolute_Error: Median Absolute Error: Robust central tendency of error, unaffected by high-leverage outliers. Lower is better.
metric_definitions_and_interpretations.R2: Coefficient of Determination: Relative proportion of target variance explained. Higher is better; not a percentage accuracy.
metric_definitions_and_interpretations.MAPE_omission_rationale: MAPE is omitted as primary metric because near-zero target values cause distorted percentage blow-ups.
